name: Vansen ChemGuard Mechanic Trouser
description: Flat-front work trousers treated with a grease-resistant silicone-polymer finish that causes most oils and solvents to bead and wipe clean. The fabric is a stiff, dark graphite weave that softens slightly with wear. Popular in vehicle bays, fabrication shops, and any Tier 2 workspace where you're kneeling on concrete by noon.
functionality: Grease-resistant and light solvent-repellent surface treatment, reinforced knees
what_it_says: You're a trades professional — competent, practical, not interested in looking anything other than what you are.
story_hooks: Vansen's ChemGuard treatment degrades after roughly two years of heavy use — workers on tight budgets sometimes re-treat old pairs with black-market spray-on sealant of questionable quality.
A mechanic wearing a pristine, barely-used pair in a rough district stands out; either they're new to the work or they're not actually a mechanic.
